A 2 m wall of sandbags that zombies can't climb, built to take blasts. Cops, boulders and grenades barely scratch it, and a full wall survives about four point-blank demolisher blasts; rockets and dynamite still wreck it.

Place the empty bags, then fill them twice with a hammer or nail gun and crushed sand (10 each fill, 5 for the low wall). Pick the piece from the radial menu: wall, low wall (1 m cover you can shoot over), corner or wall end.

Repair with Crushed Sand and Cloth.

A 3 m wall of sharpened logs: cheap, quick, and too tall for zombies to climb. When a section breaks it leaves 1 m stumps they can climb over; hammer the stumps back into a wall with 15 wood.

Band a section with 4 forged iron (hammer or nail gun) to double its health. Pick a section or a corner from the radial menu.

Repair with Wood (and Forged Iron once banded).
A double gate of sharpened logs on two heavy posts, 3 wide and 3 m tall. Open and close it like a door; it can be locked.\n\nRepair with Wood and Nails.

A chain-link screen that stops zombies but not your bullets or arrows (they can see you through it too). It sags, then tears, as it takes damage, each stage weaker; hammer a damaged fence back up a stage with 3 scrap iron. Upgrade it to heavy chain-link with 2 forged iron for twice the health. Pick a 2 m panel, a 3 m panel or a corner from the radial menu.\n\nRepair with Scrap Iron (and Forged Iron once heavy).
A 3 wide rolling gate that slides aside on its wheels. Bullets and arrows go through it, and it can be locked.\n\nRepair with Scrap Iron.

A wire-mesh cage lined with fabric that you fill with clay you've dug anyway: the cheapest strong wall, no cement mixer needed. Fill it three times with a hammer or nail gun and clay (10 each fill, 20 for the double). Like sandbags it ignores small explosives, and every single hit on it is capped at 100, so charged and infernal zombies struggle with it. A breach spills into a 1 m mound zombies can climb; refill it with clay.\n\nRepair with Clay and Cloth.

Welded steel beams that shape the horde's path. Zombies can't climb them and would rather walk a long way around than break through, while your bullets, arrows and sight pass between the beams. Lay a maze across open ground fast. A wrecked trap bends but stays a barrier; re-weld it with 6 forged iron. Pick a 2 by 2 hedgehog or a 3 wide line from the radial menu.\n\nRepair with Forged Iron.

A 3 by 3 wall cut from shipping containers, placed whole with no upgrade hits, and tough against blasts. The catch: it has one pool of health, so when it breaks the whole 3 by 3 goes at once, and a blast counts once for every cell it covers. Pick a wall or a corner and its colour from the radial menu.\n\nRepair with Forged Steel and Forged Iron.
Shipping-container cargo doors in a steel frame, 3 wide and 3 m tall. Open and close it like a door; it can be locked.\n\nRepair with Forged Steel and Forged Iron.
